title: Pokémon GO and Duolingo Timed Research

entries.name: Pikachu
entries.label: Timed Research — Normal
entries.source_text: Pokemon GO and Duolingo are teaming up! Do at least one Duolingo lesson a day for seven days to earn an offer code for Timed Research in Pokemon GO. Complete the research to earn XP, Stardust, and encounters with Pikachu, Meowth, Chatot, and Lucario that have a Special Background.
